before_body:
--!strict
-- GQ805: local read-only opening of the original #808 ShopView.
-- No fabricated wallet, no Client->Server Remote, no purchase callback or grant.
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
if not RunService:IsStudio() then return end
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local ProximityPromptService=game:GetService("ProximityPromptService")
local ReplicatedStorage=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local player=Players.LocalPlayer
local busy=false
ProximityPromptService.PromptTriggered:Connect(function(prompt:ProximityPrompt)
 if prompt.Name~="GQ805_ShopReadOnlyPrompt" then return end
 local building=prompt:FindFirstAncestor("GQ805_LobbyGuildShop")
 if not building or building:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_ShopPreviewOnly")~=true then return end
 if prompt.Parent==nil or not prompt:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return end
 local ch=player.Character
 local root=ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 local hum=ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 if not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") or not hum or hum.Health<=0 then return end
 local door=prompt.Parent
 if not door:IsA("BasePart") or (root.Position-door.Position).Magnitude>13 then return end
 if player:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_Eliminated")==true then return end
 if busy then return end
 busy=true
 local folder=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("GQ805Shop")
 local cat=folder and folder:FindFirstChild("EGGRUMBLE_LobbyShopCatalog")
 local view=folder and folder:FindFirstChild("EGGRUMBLE_LobbyShopView")
 if not cat or not view or not cat:IsA("ModuleScript") or not view:IsA("ModuleScript") then
  warn("[GQ805 KIOSK] Original #808 Catalog/ShopView ModuleScript source not selected; keep purchases OFF")
  busy=false
  return
 end
 local ok,err=pcall(function()
  local Catalog=require(cat)
  local View=require(view)
  local snapshot={
   catalog=Catalog.list(),
   points="未接続",
   owned={[Catalog.freeStarter()]=true},
   robuxEnabled=false,
  }
  local gui=View.mount(player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"),snapshot,nil)
  gui:SetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_ReadOnlyPreview",true)
 end)
 if not ok then warn("[GQ805 KIOSK] read-only UI unavailable",err) end
 busy=false
end)
after_body:
--!strict
-- GQ805: local read-only opening of the original #808 ShopView.
-- No fabricated wallet, no Client->Server Remote, no purchase callback or grant.
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
if not RunService:IsStudio() then return end
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local ProximityPromptService=game:GetService("ProximityPromptService")
local ReplicatedStorage=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local player=Players.LocalPlayer
type Request={character:Model,root:BasePart,humanoid:Humanoid,prompt:ProximityPrompt,
 door:BasePart,building:Instance,pending:boolean,cancelled:boolean,gui:ScreenGui?,
 observer:RBXScriptConnection?,destroying:RBXScriptConnection?}
local current:Request?=nil
local function inActiveMatch():boolean
 local mode=player:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_QueuedMode")
 if mode~="TEAM" and mode~="BATTLE_ROYALE" then return false end
 local world=workspace:FindFirstChild("EGGRUMBLE_LOBBY_CASTLE_MODES_PREVIEW")
 local arena=world and world:FindFirstChild(mode.."_Arena")
 return arena~=nil and arena:IsA("Folder")
  and arena:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_MatchPhase")=="ACTIVE"
end
local function retire(request:Request)
 request.cancelled=true
 if current==request then current=nil end
 if request.observer then request.observer:Disconnect();request.observer=nil end
 if request.destroying then request.destroying:Disconnect();request.destroying=nil end
 local gui=request.gui;request.gui=nil
 if gui then gui:Destroy() end
end
local function valid(request:Request,near:boolean):boolean
 if request.cancelled or current~=request or player.Character~=request.character
  or request.character.Parent==nil or request.humanoid.Health<=0
  or request.character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")~=request.root
  or request.character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")~=request.humanoid
  or player:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_Eliminated")==true or inActiveMatch() then return false end
 local prompt=request.prompt
 if prompt.Name~="GQ805_ShopReadOnlyPrompt" or prompt.Parent~=request.door
  or not prompt:IsDescendantOf(workspace)
  or prompt:FindFirstAncestor("GQ805_LobbyGuildShop")~=request.building
  or request.building:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_ShopPreviewOnly")~=true then return false end
 return not near or (request.root.Position-request.door.Position).Magnitude<=13
end
ProximityPromptService.PromptTriggered:Connect(function(prompt:ProximityPrompt)
 if prompt.Name~="GQ805_ShopReadOnlyPrompt" then return end
 local building=prompt:FindFirstAncestor("GQ805_LobbyGuildShop")
 if not building or building:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_ShopPreviewOnly")~=true then return end
 if prompt.Parent==nil or not prompt:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return end
 local ch=player.Character
 local root=ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 local hum=ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 if not ch or not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") or not hum or hum.Health<=0 then return end
 local door=prompt.Parent
 if not door:IsA("BasePart") or (root.Position-door.Position).Magnitude>13 then return end
 if player:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_Eliminated")==true or inActiveMatch() then return end
 if current and current.pending then return end
 if current then retire(current) end
 local request:Request={character=ch,root=root,humanoid=hum,prompt=prompt,
  door=door,building=building,pending=true,cancelled=false}
 current=request
 local folder=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("GQ805Shop")
 local cat=folder and folder:FindFirstChild("EGGRUMBLE_LobbyShopCatalog")
 local view=folder and folder:FindFirstChild("EGGRUMBLE_LobbyShopView")
 if not cat or not view or not cat:IsA("ModuleScript") or not view:IsA("ModuleScript") then
  warn("[GQ805 KIOSK] Original #808 Catalog/ShopView ModuleScript source not selected; keep purchases OFF")
  retire(request)
  return
 end
 -- Observe only this pending/open request, including late arena replication.
 -- Walking away after opening remains allowed; a pending open must stay near.
 request.observer=RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
  if not valid(request,request.pending) or (request.gui and request.gui.Parent==nil) then
   retire(request)
  end
 end)
 local ok,err=pcall(function()
  local Catalog=require(cat)
  if not valid(request,true) then return end
  local View=require(view)
  if not valid(request,true) then return end
  local snapshot={
   catalog=Catalog.list(),
   points="未接続",
   owned={[Catalog.freeStarter()]=true},
   robuxEnabled=false,
  }
  local parent=player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui",5)
  if not parent or not parent:IsA("PlayerGui") or not valid(request,true) then return end
  local gui=View.mount(parent,snapshot,nil)
  request.gui=gui
  if not valid(request,true) then retire(request);return end
  gui:SetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_ReadOnlyPreview",true)
  request.destroying=gui.Destroying:Connect(function() retire(request) end)
 end)
 request.pending=false
 if not ok then warn("[GQ805 KIOSK] read-only UI unavailable",err) end
 if not ok or not request.gui then retire(request) end
end)
